_meta.purpose: Parallel food-safety labelling checks. NEVER merged into rules/rules.json (Legal Metrology).
_meta.authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
_meta.legal_boundary: Implementation encoding of well-known FSSAI packaging/labelling categories. Gazette text was NOT ingested in this pass. Every rule needs_official_verification.
source_priority: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations, 2011
Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020

requirements.description: Pre-packaged food should display the FSSAI licence or registration number of the manufacturer/packer.

decision.pass_when: a licence/registration number is observed on the pack
decision.uncertain_when: the number is not readable in the provided images
decision.fail_when: never from absence alone — absence is UNCERTAIN until coverage is complete and legally verified

rules.legal_note: Thresholds and exact display form are not verified against gazette text in this repository.

requirements.description: Packaged food should carry the vegetarian or non-vegetarian identification mark.

decision.uncertain_when: the mark is not observed in the provided images

rules.legal_note: Symbol geometry is a CV/OCR observation, not a legal determination.

requirements.description: Pre-packaged food should declare a list of ingredients.

decision.uncertain_when: no ingredients list is readable in the provided images

rules.clause: Date of manufacture / packing / best before

requirements.description: Pre-packaged food should declare manufacturing/packing and/or best-before/use-by dating as applicable.

decision.uncertain_when: no date marking is readable in the provided images
